svg.title: Transactions per second: the same work with and without a temp table
svg.desc: Postgres 18.6, 16 vCPU, 32 clients, 0 idle sessions, median of 4 runs. CTE with no table: 86997 TPS. Temp table created once per session with ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS: 17866. Created once, TRUNCATE in each transaction: 4405. CREATE TEMP TABLE with ON COMMIT DROP in each transaction: 3783. Created once, DELETE in each transaction: 1514.
